evidence.mechanism: shot-08s: about nine cream undyed bands sit at the left end of a fixed-angle indigo rectangle, each squeezed band pushing the blue stripes right; by shot-20s the bands fold into a mirrored chevron.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: one stripe field with a drop shadow, paper-grain cream ground and wavy band edges; by shot-20s a mirror fold is the only added idea, a single-layer shader using 2583 of 4096 bytes.
evidence.craft: shot-20s: the fold apex and a horizontal band near the centre show moire shimmer in fine hatching; shot-02s edges and blue shading are clean, with a soft drop shadow over cream paper grain.
evidence.distinctness: shot-08s: cream and indigo cloth bands with no dye blobs, sand grid or coral, so it differs from the last 4 nights; the striped weave idea is still close to anchor-05 in form.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: the rectangle is centred with bands already at one end; by shot-20s it resolves into a smaller mirrored V that departs from the brief's pull-back rectangle, so the end state is clear.

pairwise_justification: Median's apricot sand grid fills the whole frame with vermilion fronts and umber scars; tonight's 8s is a small indigo rectangle on mostly empty cream, so the median wins the head-to-head at a thumbnail.

critique.change: Remove the moire at shot-20s: use a coarser band pitch at the mirror seam and lower the domain-warp amplitude there, so the fold shows clean stripes instead of shimmering fine hatching.
Add a second rendering idea visible at shot-08s: self-shadow each compressed band so the pleats read as folded cloth rather than flat stripes, raising ambition beyond a single shaded layer.

Make the push legible in time: show each new band entering at the top-left end and shoving the earlier bands between shot-02s and shot-08s, so the wrap-and-scrunch rule is seen happening rather than only inferred from band count.
